3.Title: Perpetual Mechanical Array
3.Desc: A mysterious ruin machine that can reconfigure itself into various forms. In battle, the Perpetual Mechanical Array will enter the Absolute Defense state, in which it splits and summons several different kinds of Ruin Sentinels. After <color=#f39001>defeating the enhanced Ruin Sentinels</color>, Absolute Defense state will be removed and it will enter a weakened state.

3.Title: Twin Fatui Operatives
3.Desc: A pair of elite Fatui special agents who can manipulate Cryo and Anemo in battle. In combat, they will use the Hunt Down skill to attach a Bond of Life to characters they hit. While Bond of Life is active, the character will take continuous DMG, and Hunt Down will deal more DMG to them.

6.Title: Goldflame Qucusaur Tyrant
6.Desc: A Qucusaurus whose extraordinary form is a result of being unable to withstand the great power it has been granted. It will fly into the air during combat and enter the "Golden Flame" energy-gathering form, creating a Ward around itself and launching a Flamewind Feather towards the ground that summons a flamewind. If you cannot destroy the Flamewind Feather before the Qucusaurus dives down into it, the creature will use a Phlogiston Current to return to the skies. This will persist until it is exhausted and returns to its original form. It seems, then, that <color=#f39001>destroying the Flamewind Feather using Elements that react with Pyro</color> may be the key to victory...

8.Title: Tenebrous Papilla
8.Desc: A great black monster that has come from the abyssal dark, eroding the memories of the earth. It can warp itself and transform into a formidable foe. Some of its attacks can cause stackable Attrition that, after a time, will cause your active character to lose HP. During combat, the Tenebrous Papilla will use Beseech the Dark to grant itself a Void Ward. At this time, use <color=#f39001>a certain number of elemental attacks</color> to break the Ward, which will cause it to enter a confused state. <color=#f39001>Nightsoul-aligned elemental attacks</color> will break the Ward more effectively.
